useful_references.title: Solutions to the 84th William Lowell Putnam Mathematical Competition
expanded_definitions: The unoccupied squares are the vertices of a monotone path using unit down and left steps.
applicability_check: The initial empty set is exactly the last column union the last row.
A legal move replaces a down-left two-step corner of this path by the left-down corner across the same unit square.
proof_insights: Encode paths as step words; the move is the adjacent transposition DL to LD, and all words with fixed content are reachable from D^(m-1)L^(n-1).
useful_references.why_useful: It supplies the decisive invariant and a direct reachability mechanism; the eventual proof is self-contained and does not cite an external theorem.
